verses.zh: 你若与官长坐席，要留意在你面前的是谁。
verses.kjv: When thou sittest to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before thee:
verses.en: When you sit down to eat with an important person, pay careful attention to what is in front of you.

verses.zh: 你若是贪食的，就当拿刀放在喉咙上。
verses.kjv: And put a knife to thy throat, if thou be a man given to appetite.
verses.en: If you tend to eat too much, it is like putting a knife to your own throat.

verses.zh: 不可贪恋他的美食，因为是哄人的食物。
verses.kjv: Be not desirous of his dainties: for they are deceitful meat.
verses.en: Do not long for his fine food, because that meal is meant to fool you.

verses.zh: 不要劳碌求富，休仗自己的聪明。
verses.kjv: Labour not to be rich: cease from thine own wisdom.
verses.en: Do not wear yourself out trying to get rich; be wise enough to stop.

verses.zh: 你岂要定睛在虚无的钱财上吗？因钱财必长翅膀，如鹰向天飞去。
verses.kjv: Wilt thou set thine eyes upon that which is not? for riches certainly make themselves wings; they fly away as an eagle toward heaven.
verses.en: Why fix your eyes on money that is not even there? It sprouts wings and flies off like an eagle.

verses.zh: 不要吃恶眼人的饭，也不要贪他的美味；
verses.kjv: Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye, neither desire thou his dainty meats:
verses.en: Do not eat the food of a stingy person, or long for his tasty dishes,

verses.zh: 因为他心怎样思量，他为人就是怎样。他虽对你说，请吃，请喝，他的心却与你相背。
verses.kjv: For as he thinketh in his heart, so is he: Eat and drink, saith he to thee; but his heart is not with thee.
verses.en: because he is the sort who counts every bite. "Eat! Drink!" he says, but his heart is not with you.

verses.zh: 你所吃的那点食物必吐出来；你所说的甘美言语也必落空。
verses.kjv: The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, and lose thy sweet words.
verses.en: You will be sick up the little you ate, and all your polite words will be wasted.

verses.zh: 你不要说话给愚昧人听，因他必藐视你智慧的言语。
verses.kjv: Speak not in the ears of a fool: for he will despise the wisdom of thy words.
verses.en: Do not bother speaking to a fool, because he will only look down on your wise words.

verses.zh: 不可挪移古时的地界，也不可侵入孤儿的田地；
verses.kjv: Remove not the old landmark; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless:
verses.en: Do not move the old boundary stone or move in on land belonging to children with no father,

verses.zh: 因他们的救赎主大有能力，他必向你为他们辨屈。
verses.kjv: For their redeemer is mighty; he shall plead their cause with thee.
verses.en: because the one who protects them is strong, and he will take up their case against you.

verses.zh: 你要留心领受训诲，侧耳听从知识的言语。
verses.kjv: Apply thine heart unto instruction, and thine ears to the words of knowledge.
verses.en: Set your heart on being taught, and your ears on words of knowledge.

verses.zh: 不可不管教孩童；你用杖打他，他必不至于死。
verses.kjv: Withhold not correction from the child: for if thou beatest him with the rod, he shall not die.
verses.en: Do not leave a child uncorrected; correcting him will not be the end of him.

verses.zh: 你要用杖打他，就可以救他的灵魂免下阴间。
verses.kjv: Thou shalt beat him with the rod, and shalt deliver his soul from hell.
verses.en: Correct him, and you will save his life from the place of the dead.

verses.zh: 我儿，你心若存智慧，我的心也甚欢喜。
verses.kjv: My son, if thine heart be wise, my heart shall rejoice, even mine.
verses.en: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad too.

verses.zh: 你的嘴若说正直话，我的心肠也必快乐。
verses.kjv: Yea, my reins shall rejoice, when thy lips speak right things.
verses.en: I will be delighted deep inside when your lips say what is right.

verses.zh: 你心中不要嫉妒罪人，只要终日敬畏耶和华；
verses.kjv: Let not thine heart envy sinners: but be thou in the fear of the LORD all the day long.
verses.en: Do not let your heart be jealous of people who do wrong; always respect the LORD instead,

verses.zh: 因为至终必有善报，你的指望也不致断绝。
verses.kjv: For surely there is an end; and thine expectation shall not be cut off.
verses.en: because there is a future for you, and what you hope for will not be cut off.

verses.zh: 我儿，你当听，当存智慧，好在正道上引导你的心。
verses.kjv: Hear thou, my son, and be wise, and guide thine heart in the way.
verses.en: Listen, my son, and be wise; keep your heart on the right road.

verses.zh: 好饮酒的，好吃肉的，不要与他们来往；
verses.kjv: Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh:
verses.en: Do not spend time with heavy drinkers or people who stuff themselves with meat,

verses.zh: 因为好酒贪食的，必致贫穷；好睡觉的，必穿破烂衣服。
verses.kjv: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags.
verses.en: because drinkers and big eaters end up poor, and sleeping all day leaves a person in rags.

verses.zh: 你要听从生你的父亲；你母亲老了，也不可藐视她。
verses.kjv: Hearken unto thy father that begat thee, and despise not thy mother when she is old.
verses.en: Listen to your father, who gave you life, and do not look down on your mother when she is old.

verses.zh: 你当买真理；就是智慧、训诲，和聪明也都不可卖。
verses.kjv: Buy the truth, and sell it not; also wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.
verses.en: Buy the truth and never sell it — and the same with wisdom, teaching and understanding.

verses.zh: 义人的父亲必大得快乐；人生智慧的儿子，必因他欢喜。
verses.kjv: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice: and he that begetteth a wise child shall have joy of him.
verses.en: The father of a good child is very glad, and whoever has a wise child is happy in them.

verses.zh: 你要使父母欢喜，使生你的快乐。
verses.kjv: Thy father and thy mother shall be glad, and she that bare thee shall rejoice.
verses.en: Make your father and mother glad; give the one who gave you birth a reason to rejoice.

verses.zh: 我儿，要将你的心归我；你的眼目也要喜悦我的道路。
verses.kjv: My son, give me thine heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways.
verses.en: My son, give me your heart, and let your eyes delight in my ways.

verses.zh: 妓女是深坑；外女是窄阱。
verses.kjv: For a whore is a deep ditch; and a strange woman is a narrow pit.
verses.en: That kind of woman is a deep pit, a narrow well you cannot climb out of.

verses.zh: 她埋伏好像强盗；她使人中多有奸诈的。
verses.kjv: She also lieth in wait as for a prey, and increaseth the transgressors among men.
verses.en: She waits in hiding like a robber, and leads more and more people into doing wrong.

verses.zh: 谁有祸患？谁有忧愁？谁有争斗？谁有哀叹？谁无故受伤？谁眼目红赤？
verses.kjv: Who hath woe? who hath sorrow? who hath contentions? who hath babbling? who hath wounds without cause? who hath redness of eyes?
verses.en: Who ends up in trouble? Who is sad? Who is fighting? Who is complaining? Who gets hurt for no reason? Whose eyes are red?

verses.zh: 就是那流连饮酒、常去寻找调和酒的人。
verses.kjv: They that tarry long at the wine; they that go to seek mixed wine.
verses.en: It is the people who sit too long over their wine, always looking for another mixed drink.

verses.zh: 酒发红，在杯中闪烁，你不可观看，虽然下咽舒畅，终久是咬你如蛇，刺你如毒蛇。
verses.kjv: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, when it giveth his colour in the cup, when it moveth itself aright. At the last it biteth like a serpent, and stingeth like an adder.
verses.en: Do not stare at the wine when it glows red and sparkles in the cup and slips down so smoothly — in the end it bites like a snake and stings like a viper.

verses.zh: 你眼必看见异怪的事；你心必发出乖谬的话。
verses.kjv: Thine eyes shall behold strange women, and thine heart shall utter perverse things.
verses.en: Your eyes will see strange things, and your heart will say twisted things.

verses.zh: 你必像躺在海中，或像卧在桅杆上。
verses.kjv: Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea, or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast.
verses.en: You will feel like someone lying out at sea, or lying on top of a swaying mast.

verses.zh: 你必说：人打我，我却未受伤；人鞭打我，我竟不觉得。我几时清醒，我仍去寻酒。
verses.kjv: They have stricken me, shalt thou say, and I was not sick; they have beaten me, and I felt it not: when shall I awake? I will seek it yet again.
verses.en: You will say: "They hit me, but I felt nothing. They beat me, but I did not notice. When will I wake up? I want another drink."
